scope: Prepared over-air FT AUTH retry callback admission helper

coverage: Real AUTH event matcher, retry snapshot/current-identity helpers and pending lease acquisition execute against host frame/MLME/adapter schemas.
Matching AUTH frame and both queued stamps obtain one pending-scope lease; leave balances ownership.

Fourteen refusal scenarios: pending metadata mixed in, association generation/WCID/addr disagreement, retry serial/BSSID mismatch, short/oversized frame, wrong transaction/address, changed published generation/state.

limits: Native APPeerAuthReqAtIdleAction dispatch and RX selector are not yet composed with retry helper.
MLME/frame schema and MacTabLock precondition use explicit host actors; no full target TUs compiled.
Prepared code remains uninstalled; IAPP/native completion integration, final image and device acceptance remain open.
